apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Sales: type each item's Market Price, then give a discount on the whole sale (type what the customer paid, or a Discount %) or on one item. The Sold Price after the discount is what's recorded, and Accounting shows the Discounts. An item can't go on Outgoing Items more times than it's in stock.
